scope: Configuration and frozen-source control-flow review only. Separate CPU route/continuous-rate/clearance review remains required; no new native outcome inferred.
initial_offset_semantics: COM target offset from freshly measured initial mouth XY area centroid; not a guarantee of fixed +20mm at later observations.

unchanged_policy.note: Lateral/overlap/perimeter are declared trial policies, not physical laws. Explicit lateral/overlap values permit a bounded contact experiment, not a material-feasibility claim. The initial COM search radius does not change the 30 mm individual or 50 mm cumulative correction budget. The 5 mm minimum teddy/left-robot clearance is an engineering preflight allowance, not a physical law. Bottom clearance and lateral trial fraction are configurable; no compression is prescribed.

fallback.anchor: New actual TCP XY, not moving mouth centroid
fallback.trigger: Fresh vertical-only reobservation rejected after initial preparation, or after prior bounded correction.
fallback.stop_conditions: No admissible correction or fresh insertion still rejected after two corrections raises GateFailure before insertion.
fallback.action: Each accepted correction executes height-at-current-XY plus one fixed-orientation XY translation, then requires strictly newer native observation before insertion.
fallback.selection: First declared correction passing all existing gates; list order is consequential.
fallback.rationale: Retaining the pre-existing bounded fallback does not itself weaken physical gates or cause an unconditional move. It changes the interpretation of this experiment: an initial +Y20 proposal with possible fresh-state correction, not a fixed-XY treatment. Any improved or failed outcome must identify whether corrections actually executed.
required_future_audit_evidence: guarded_contact_reobservations actual clocks and saved states
recenter_height_* and recenter_teddy_xy_* actual event/endpoints if executed
fresh final insert observation and final actual containment
